context: Two managers discuss a launch event
purpose: Teach: 本田/石田/安田/川口/神田/大塚/野口/高木

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発表会、本田さんが司会、石田さんが進行管理ね。
lines.en: The launch presentation — Honda-san will MC, Ishida-san on logistics.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient. Light breath-in on the opening. Scanning a mental checklist. Quick clip to each name. No hesitation — she's already thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。安田さんが、受付。川口さんが警備配置を担当します。
lines.en: Right. Yasuda on reception, Kawaguchi handling security setup.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Taking notes without making a show of it. Matching her rhythm — the rapport of two people who work well together.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 神田さん、大塚さんは、プレス対応をお願い。
lines.en: Kanda and Otsuka — I need you on press handling.
lines.style: Clear assignment, gentle authority. Direct eye contact implied. Not demanding, but expecting them to understand the trust she's placing in them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 野口さんが質疑、高木さんが資料の最終チェックです。
lines.en: Noguchi's on Q&A, Takagi's doing final material review.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Factual, brief. The voice of someone ticking boxes off a list. Small pause between the two assignments — letting each one land.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Quiet firmness on the final word. Weight behind it — not harsh, but uncompromising. A small breath before 'no gaps' — the last word carries everything.
